_doc: Probe P6 scale cross-check, expressed as camera height h above the floor (the ground-plane scale is proportional to h; scale factor = h / 4.0 m prior). Zero-roll pinhole after CAL v0 k1; tilt fitted from person boxes. people = RF-DETR-M person boxes (conf >= 0.5, upright, unoccluded, not at the border) on the t=0.5 s frame of TRAIN clips, walker height 1.72 m, robust LS; stripes = painted floor lines assumed 10 cm wide, both edges traced on the TRAIN median background. Fallback rule (PLAN_TWIN §3 P6): estimates disagree by more than 20 % -> publish a scale interval and run the robot at both ends. Details: docs/probes/S3a-P6.md.
